SELECT p."id", p."user_id", p."category_id", p."title", p."slug", p."status", p."is_top", p."view_count", p."like_count", p."comment_count", p."created_at", COALESCE(u."nickname", u."username") AS "author_name", c."name" AS "category_name" FROM "BLOG"."posts" p LEFT JOIN "BLOG"."users" u ON u."id"=p."user_id" LEFT JOIN "BLOG"."categories" c ON c."id"=p."category_id" WHERE p."deleted_at" IS NULL AND p."status"=#{query.status} AND p."category_id"=#{query.categoryId} AND p."user_id"=#{query.authorId} AND p."user_id"=#{visibleAuthorId}
AND (LOWER(p."title") LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(p."slug") LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(u."nickname") LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(u."username") LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(CAST(p."id" AS VARCHAR(30))) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!')
ORDER BY
p."view_count" DESC, p."like_count" DESC, p."created_at" DESC, p."is_top" DESC, p."created_at" DESC,
p."id" DESC
